title: Quarterly sprint templating & signal-latch for hosted API + model catalog
creator: Aisha Nunez
description: Define and ship a repeatable quarterly sprint template that ties hosted API model catalog decisions to explicit signal thresholds (a 'signal-latch') that drive commit lanes, canary windows, and contingency actions. The goal is to reduce ad-hoc roadmap shifts by providing engineers and stakeholders a predictable template for: 1) when to gate a model onboarding or rotation, 2) which metrics must pass for a canary to graduate, and 3) automated fallback/reroute policies when capacity or quality signals cross critical thresholds. This initiative combines PM playbook work, a lightweight templates pack for squad planning, and a short-run automation checklist for Console to display latch states on per-model dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: A quarterly sprint template (.md) exists and is adopted by at least 3 hosted API product squads
Signal-latch spec published that enumerates metrics (latency P95, cost-per-1k-tokens, eval-regression delta, error-rate) and thresholds for green/amber/red
Canary graduation checklist integrated into the Console runbook view with a visual latch state mock
Two example playbook runs documented with links to retrospective notes showing reduced manual triage time
Automated alert mapping for at least 2 critical signals (P95 latency and eval-regression delta) wired into oncall runbooks
tasks: Define signal set and thresholds with Applied ML and SRE
Design Console latch UI mock and run it by Design
Implement lightweight Console flag to display latch state (Eng)
Pilot template with Hosted API squad for one sprint and collect metrics
Write post-pilot retro and update the template
